subject: Wire the context-gate into the live consult path (gated retrieval)
description:
The calibrated gate (lib/context-gate.js — recall 1.00 / precision 1.00 on the 9-case regression set) has no consumers. Wire it into the live retrieval path so agents get knowledge ONLY when the gate says it's load-bearing, and abstain (no injection, no over-deliberation tax) otherwise.

INTEGRATION SEAMS (implement both):
1. DAEMON: a gate evaluation exposed where retrieval happens — either a new GET/POST /gate route (task text in, decision+notes out) or a `gated=1` mode on the existing /search route: run gateTask over the workspace's embedded notes (daemon already lazy-loads embed for /search); if INJECT → return the top note(s) + decision metadata; if ABSTAIN → return {decision:'abstain', reason} and NO notes. Honor per-request `workspace` (write-side pattern from task #6 — targetOverlay/load; reads of overlay for gating should accept the param directly).
2. MCP/TOOL LAYER: surface it to agents — either a new tool (e.g. `consult_gate`) or make `search_knowledge` accept gated mode — and update the consult-path guidance (orch-loop / parallel-orchestrate skill prompt assembly, bench-arm consult preambles if trivial) so the default flow is: ask the gate first; retrieve only on INJECT.

REQUIREMENTS: backward compatible (ungated search_knowledge keeps working; gate-off = current behavior); the gate's localityThreshold/thresholds read from the module DEFAULTS (no new config sprawl); the abstain response must be cheap and small. Tests: route-level (gated search returns abstain on a non-local-topic task, inject on a project-local match — reuse regression-set fixtures), plus existing suites green (test/context-gate*.test.js 28+9, workspace tests 25). 

HAZARDS: daemon.js is hot (heartbeat workers edit it) — git status first, rebase if needed, verify `grep -c targetOverlay daemon.js` == 21 after your edits (do NOT clobber the #6 fix). Do NOT restart the daemon (user controls); state restart-required. MiniLM lazy-load latency on first gate call is acceptable — note it.
